name: Connected agent (A2A)
summary: Caller agent that delegates to a remote agent via RemoteA2A connection.
description: Creates a caller agent with a RemoteA2A tool / connection pointing at another agent's endpoint. The caller's orchestrator model can be BYOM-routed; the callee is configured independently. Validates that the cross-agent protocol does not strip the BYOM prefix.
notes: Skips unless `A2A_PROJECT_CONNECTION_ID` (an A2A connection registered in the Foundry project) or `A2A_ENDPOINT` (external A2A server URL) is set. A plain Prompt Agent is NOT an A2A server — Foundry doesn't auto-expose `/agents/<name>` in A2A protocol format, so this cannot be self-provisioned end-to-end without a real A2A backend. BYOM routing of the caller-side orchestrator has not been validated end-to-end yet.
